role: XCTest suite for LiveReadiness.compute (the dashboard's 'right now' readiness): morning-only fallbacks, drift flags, day-fraction ATL/CTL interpolation, rest-day acute-fatigue gating, the 72 h recent-load filter, hoursSinceMorning, WorkoutDescriptor selection/phrase, headline and loop-card text.
types: LiveReadinessTests: class — XCTestCase over LiveReadiness and WorkoutDescriptor

units.does: Computed fixture: today's date at 12:00 local, or Date() if Calendar cannot set the hour.

branches.effect: falls back to the current time only if the calendar returns nil

units.does: Asserts compute(78, no session, no metrics) returns score and morningRecovery 78 with both flags false.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Asserts compute(85, session, no metrics) returns score 85 and morningRecovery 85.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: With ATL 30/CTL 35 and no training today asserts readiness is within ±12 of the morning 75 and todayTrimp 0.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Morning 90, hard 60-min run 3 h ago, todayTrimp 120: asserts score < morning, pulledDownByTodaysTraining true, liftedByRecovery false, and todayPrimaryWorkout typeLabel 'run'.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Morning ATL 40 → live 35, CTL flat, no training: asserts score ≥ morning recovery.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Asserts pulledDownByTodaysTraining == (morningReadiness − score ≥ 3), liftedByRecovery == (score − morningReadiness ≥ 3) and not both: the drift is measured from the model at the frozen morning anchor, not from the raw recovery score.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Hour 0 with snapshot ATL 30 / CTL 40 equal to live, no training, recovery 60: asserts the score is at least 3 above the recovery score (precondition), equals morningReadiness within 0.01, and neither liftedByRecovery nor pulledDownByTodaysTraining fires — a model/recovery gap present at the reading is not drift.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Morning ATL 40/CTL 50, live ATL 34: asserts readiness 24 h later is greater than at acceptance (day-fraction interpolation).
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Session ended 36 h ago with morning ATL 60 vs live 35 (CTL 40): asserts hoursSinceMorning > 24, that the score equals RecoveryScoreCalculator.calculateReadiness for live ATL 35 / CTL 40 / ACR 0.875 with no morning ATL (no freshness bonus) within 0.01, and that it is more than 5 points below the same calculation with yesterday's morning ATL 60 (the bonus the suppression removes).
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Asserts a rest day with a 20 h-old hard workout scores at least the active-day (todayTrimp 50) score minus 1: the workout is before the start of the morning reading's day, so compute leaves it out of the acute-fatigue loads and the rest day pays nothing for it.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Training day: reading ended 06:00, yesterday's run 20 h ago and today's 40-min run 2 h ago, todayTrimp 50. Asserts today's run carries load (precondition) and that LiveReadiness.acuteFatigueLoad equals only today's run decayed over 2 h (userScaledLoad · e^(−2/τ), τ = acuteFatigueTauHours) within 0.01 — yesterday's run, before the morning anchor, is left out.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Asserts recentWorkoutLoads keeps the 24 h-old workout and drops the 96 h-old one, with hoursAgo ≈24.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

branches.effect: 0 when no load survives, failing the ≈24 assertion

units.does: Asserts a workout dated 2 h in the future is skipped, so recentWorkoutLoads returns nil.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Asserts recentWorkoutLoads returns nil with no workouts.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Asserts hoursSinceMorning is 5 for a session that ended 5 h before now.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Asserts hoursSinceMorning ≥ 0 for a session ending 1 h in the future.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Asserts todayPrimary picks the hard 50-min run over an easy 25-min walk (typeLabel 'run').
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Asserts WorkoutDescriptor(ride, 60, moderate).phrase == 'moderate 60-min ride'.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Asserts todayPrimary of [] is nil.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Asserts an 827-min 'workout' is excluded so the 45-min run is picked (duration ≤ 360).
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

branches.effect: 999 when no descriptor, failing the ≤ 360 assertion

units.does: Asserts todayPrimary returns nil when the only workout is 800 min.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Morning 92, no training snapshot, hard 45-min run 2 h ago: asserts pulledDownByTodaysTraining (the morning anchor at zero load reads the full 92, the run drags the score far below it), then that the headline rendered in English (NarrativeLanguage.english) contains 'run' and 'min'.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Unremarkable day: if neither flag is set, asserts loopCardText is nil.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

branches.effect: asserts loopCardText nil; otherwise asserts nothing

units.does: Fixture: overnight session of 8 h ending sessionEndAgoHours before now, with recoveryScore and optional trainingSnapshot.
Fixture: TrainingContext with given ATL/CTL, TSB = CTL − ATL.
Fixture: TrainingMetrics with ATL/CTL/TSB, todayTrimp and recentWorkouts (no todayWorkouts).
Fixture: HealthKitManager.WorkoutSummary at now − hoursAgo with type, duration and average HR.
